title: GitHub Classic personal access token: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: github_pat_ (documented fine-grained personal access token prefix) vs contracted ghp_. Twin of "GitHub App server-to-server token, GitHub App user-to-server token and 3 more: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of github-token-ghp-plain: prefix namespace: github_pat_ (documented fine-grained personal access token prefix) vs contracted ghp_. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
